maria: Follow-up from authz postmortem 95: token-validator GC pauses caused JWKS fetches to block. Need owners for hotfix, audit events, secrets rotation, and a short verification cadence. Add tasks here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AuthzActions

devsec-bot: INCIDENT RDW-2026-318 updated: affected clusters eu-west-1, hosted API. Severity P2. logs: https://logs.redwood.example/incident/2026-318

jamie: I'll own the hotfix: non-blocking JWKS + cache fallback + simple circuit-breaker. ETA: patch to staging 04/08 EOD, canary 04/09 morning.

alex: I'll own telemetry & alerts + audit schema. Plan: add jwks_fetch_ms histogram, emit authz.audit events (tenant_id, token_hash, verdict). ETA 04/10.

tanya: I'll draft segmented customer comms and hold until we verify canary.

kevin: Devsec ops: i'll coordinate service-principal rotation and verification scripts. proposed window 04/12 02:00-03:30 UTC.

maria: Proposed verification cadence: synthetic token checks daily for 7 days post-deploy, then weekly for 4 weeks. Also 4x 20-min syncs over first month. Please confirm owners in sheet and ack with :eyes:.

jamie: :eyes: confirmed. I'll paste a short runbook snippet in the sheet tonight.

alex: :eyes: will open telemetry PR today and add dashboards.

tanya: :eyes: ready to send comms after canary green.

maria: Thanks everyone. If dates slip, update the tracker and ping me.
